expectations.text: The response identifies the power gradient - students reporting on the professors who grade them and the recruiters they want jobs from - as the decisive fact for channel design.
expectations.evidence: Finding #1, ranked most severe, is titled 'The power structure makes a face-to-face-only channel unusable for the highest-risk reports'. It says: 'Judges grade these students, and recruiters decide internships. Those are the people a student is least able to report.' It also warns of 'retaliation in grades or hiring'. The redesign follows from this point: it adds 'an independent external contact... not tied to grading, sponsors, or the university chain', requires 'organizers who are not students or university graders', and sets out 'Power-imbalance protections'.
